title: Web search arguments, version 1
description: The canonical arguments a caller hands /acquire for the source web-search, and adapter-sources --provider web-search reads on stdin (docs/web-search.md). Each value is checked on its own: member sets, types and lexical forms, with patterns written to mean the same under a JavaScript and a Python regular-expression engine. The schema is looser than the adapter in these places, and a value it admits may be one the adapter refuses: the length of a query is counted here in characters and by the adapter in bytes of UTF-8; whether the connection exists, and whether the revision is its present one, is not known here; the names of the members are the ones written here, where the adapter's reader also takes a name written in another case; and the canonical domain of SPEC.md section 1.1 is not known here, since a schema reads JSON that has been parsed, where a member named twice is one member and 5.0 is the integer 5.

connection.description: the name of a saved connection

revision.description: the revision of the connection the caller read from its status; a request that names another than the present one is refused as source-changed

query.description: what to search for, 1 to 2000 bytes of UTF-8 with no control character

maxResults.description: the most hits the result may hold
